game.name: battlecode-2026
game.description: MIT Battlecode 2026 with the original Java 21 engine, maps, rules, and per-robot bytecode budgets.

player.value: Submit a ZIP containing src/<package>/RobotPlayer.java and Java dependencies. Optional root battlecode.json selects {"package":"SPAARK"}; a single RobotPlayer is auto-detected. The original RobotController/Clock API executes inside the JVM with upstream instrumentation. No player WebSocket or separate container is used.

global.value: GET /client/global shows episode status and links to the original Battlecode replay viewer after completion. /global is a WebSocket sending JSON phase/result snapshots and answering Ping frames. This initial port does not stream live board frames. Replays are original gzip-compressed FlatBuffers .bc26 files.

readme.value: Battlecode 2026: Java 21 source policies run under the original JVM engine and per-robot bytecode limits. Upload a ZIP with src/; choose an entrypoint using battlecode.json when there are multiple RobotPlayer classes. See https://github.com/Metta-AI/coworld-battlecode-2026 for packaging and local testing, and https://releases.battlecode.org/specs/battlecode26/ for the original rules. Slots 0 and 1 are teams A and B. Winners receive 1, losers 0. Maps retain their original seeds, round caps and tiebreaks.
